$schemaComment: Reviewed NuGet.org repository-signing certificate fingerprints used to pin `dotnet nuget verify --certificate-fingerprint` for the anchor packages. Do not add author-signing certificates here: only a NuGet.org repository signature proves a package was actually published to nuget.org, which is the public receipt this tool relies on.
